name: Cottage Grove
seo_title: Cottage Grove OR Christmas Events for Kids 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Cottage Grove, Oregon for 2026: Winter Wonderland lights, a downtown Christmas Kick-Off, museum candlelight and Creswell.
lede: Cottage Grove has a walk-through Winter Wonderland of lights at the speedway, a downtown Christmas Kick-Off on December 5, the museum's Stained Glass and Candlelight evening, a Cottage Theatre holiday play and the Creswell Winter Lights Festival.
celebrates: Cottage Grove's holiday season centers on Winter Wonderland at Cottage Grove Speedway, a walk-through light display open on selected nights from November 27 to December 31, 2026. The City of Cottage Grove lists the Christmas Kick-Off on Main Street on December 5 from 5 to 8 pm. On December 12 the Cottage Grove Museum lights its restored stained glass windows for free, and Creswell holds its 23rd annual Winter Lights Festival the same day. Cottage Theatre stages Miss Bennet: Christmas at Pemberley from December 4 to 20.
lastyear: The Cottage Grove Sentinel's recap of the 2025 kickoff reported the tree lighting at All America Square, 711 E Main, with the South Lane School District Choir, Santa's Workshop in the Armory, and Santa at the Dr. Snapp House bazaar from noon to 2 pm on December 6. The museum's Stained Glass and Candlelight was its 12th that evening. In Creswell, the Chronicle reported a December 13 festival with a holiday market, Santa photos and a light parade at about 5 pm.
facts: Cottage Grove Speedway sits at 2150 N Douglas Street and says its Winter Wonderland has thousands of lights, a hot chocolate bar, fire pits, a nightly dinner and dessert menu and enclosed tent seating, with cash only at the gate. Cottage Theatre is at 700 Village Drive. Creswell's festival is in its 23rd year.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Cottage Grove for 2026. For more events in the area, see our Eugene page.
traditions: A walk-through light display with a hot chocolate bar and fire pits on selected nights from November 27 to December 31.
The city's downtown kickoff on Main Street on Saturday, December 5, from 5 to 8 pm.
The museum lights its restored windows from outside on December 12, with a tour at 6:15 pm, free.
A holiday play at 700 Village Drive on December 4 to 20, with Sunday matinees.
The chamber's 23rd annual festival on December 12, with times to be posted.
kidfact: Cottage Grove Speedway's Winter Wonderland has a hot chocolate bar and fire pits, and Creswell's Winter Lights Festival is in its 23rd year.
faq: How does Cottage Grove celebrate Christmas?
With Winter Wonderland at Cottage Grove Speedway, the downtown Christmas Kick-Off on December 5, the museum's Stained Glass and Candlelight on December 12 and a holiday play at Cottage Theatre.
When is the Cottage Grove Christmas Kick-Off?
The City of Cottage Grove lists it for Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 pm on Main Street.
Is Winter Wonderland at Cottage Grove Speedway open every night?
No. The speedway's schedule lists November 27 to 29, December 4 to 6, December 11 to 13 and December 17 to 31, from 5 to 9 pm.
Is Stained Glass and Candlelight free?
Yes. The listing says free admission with donations welcome, on December 12 from 5:30 to 7 pm.
Are there events near Cottage Grove?
Yes. This page also lists the Creswell Winter Lights Festival on December 12 in nearby Creswell.
